§6N-Type Wafer Doping§f

§aElectron-rich silicon for every basic QMD controller. This is where it all starts.§f

N-Type Doped Silicon is made by placing a Silicon Wafer into a powered Fission Irradiator. The recipe costs 120,000 RF and bombards the wafer with neutrons from uranium.

You need a silicon boule first, grown from raw silicon and hafnium via the Ore Leacher and NC Manufactory chain. Slice the boule into wafers with the Manufactory, then irradiate.

N-Type is an ingredient in Basic Processors, detector casings, accelerator controllers, and more. You will be making a lot of this.

§ePS:§f The Fission Irradiator only works while receiving neutron flux from an adjacent running reactor. Build the reactor first.
